scripts.watch: watchexec -r -f 'api/**/*.rs' -f 'templates/**/*.html' -f '**/*.toml' "concurrently -k 'cargo run' 'wait-on -c wait-on.config.js && ng-openapi -c openapi.config.ts && ng build -c development --watch'"
scripts.test: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy && cargo test && prettier . -c && concurrently -s first -k "cargo run" "wait-on -c wait-on.config.js && ng-openapi -c openapi.config.ts" && ng lint && ng test --no-watch --no-progress
scripts.build: concurrently -s first -k "cargo run" "wait-on -c wait-on.config.js && ng-openapi -c openapi.config.ts" && ng build
